scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cross-env PORT=5003 npm --prefix chpl-food-backend run server
scripts.build: npm install --prefix chpl-food-backend --include=dev && npm install --prefix chpl-food-frontend --include=dev && npm --prefix chpl-food-frontend run build
